evals.prompt: 用户已经选定一个高设计水印方案，并要求真实落地。agent 改了旧绘制函数、补了颜色和测试，准备回复“已完成”。
evals.expected_output: 先建立 Delivery Contract 和 Plan-To-Implementation Map，识别旧路径陷阱；只有真实成片/样张或用户确认支持目标时才允许说完成，否则降级为 engineering-complete 或 partial。

assertions.text: Separates the user's goal and fixed design plan from engineering proxy evidence.
Identifies old fallback or old renderer patching as a delivery risk.
Requires final user-visible artifact evidence for visual/design completion.
Prevents saying complete when only tests, build, or commit evidence exists.

evals.prompt: 用户指出之前已经设计了新机制，但最终效果仍像旧机制，并问为什么目标远未达成却多次说完成。
evals.expected_output: 产出失败复盘和新的交付门槛：测试通过、APK 对齐、commit 只是工程证据；新机制必须映射到真实实现路径；最终声明要按 complete / engineering-complete / partial / blocked 分级。

assertions.text: States that tests, APK/source alignment, and commits are not sufficient proof of goal completion.
Requires mapping the new mechanism to the actual runtime or output path.
Uses graded completion claim permission instead of a binary done/not-done claim.
Names missing evidence or external gates instead of hiding them.

evals.prompt: 评审建议 done-claim-gate 参考 user-value-architect、product-sense-refiner、abstraction-architect，但不能盲目吸收。
evals.expected_output: 只吸收适配交付验收的局部机制：用户可感知价值门槛、Fact/Judgment/Expression 完成声明分层、旧机制表达上限判断；拒绝自动启动三个完整重流程。

assertions.text: Borrows user-perceived value only as an acceptance gate, not a full value-analysis workflow.
Uses Fact/Judgment/Expression to prevent misleading completion wording.
Uses old-mechanism ceiling checks only when the implementation path cannot express the fixed plan.
Explicitly rejects blind absorption or automatic chaining of the referenced skills.

evals.prompt: 用户说“你现在只是改交付口径，这不是真正的标准；目标还是没实现”。任务是高设计水印，旧函数补丁已经反复失败。
evals.expected_output: 运行 Goal Realization Gate：回到用户目标和已定方案，证明当前实现是否经过正确机制、最终样张是否接近设计目标、旧路径是否仍在冒充新方案；如果没有最终视觉证据或机制错位，只能判 partial/not-complete，并继续修复真实缺口。

assertions.text: Treats completion wording changes as insufficient when the goal is still unrealized.
Requires final artifact or multimodal evidence for visual/design targets.
Checks whether old drawing functions, fallbacks, or weak substitute paths are still carrying the implementation.
Downgrades the completion level when realization evidence is absent, even if tests and commits exist.
